headRight.text: Each crop is cut from the same pixel region of the light and the dark capture and follows the deck theme. No text is smaller than it is on the site.

items.caption: The header pairs an outlined Sign In button with a filled Get a Demo button, and the page rail starts at its hairline.
The two pricing cards share one vertical seam, and only the Enterprise card has a dotted plate and an accent border.
Customer logos sit in ruled cells with one hairline per seam, in a single ink at a common cap height.
The table of contents marks the active heading and its sub-heading with a hairline that steps in at an elbow.
The 404 page states the failure in full sentences and offers a filled and an outlined button over the ring artwork.
The footer rule meets the page rail at a registration cross, and the link columns are set at one text size.
